source_policy.historical_versions: keep separate; never select solely by basename
source_policy.runtime_copy: only selected derived assets, with source IDs and hashes

geometry.near_zero_area_faces: record; do not delete without a reviewed derived repair
geometry.matrix_policy: retain local vertices, frame matrices, scene transforms and animation transforms separately; verify composition before conversion

textures.color_key_conversion: preview only; no production alpha conversion confirmed
textures.uv_outside_0_1: retain; sampler wrapping must be verified
textures.texture_list_policy: preserve ordered list rows and duplicate keys; explicit lists and batch fallback remain separate

animation.raw_event_fields: retain both fields; candidate event-1 mapping is not runtime verified
animation.character_to_man_mapping: unconfirmed; demonstration role bindings are excluded

scenes.light_and_fog: retain source attributes; do not assume renderer-equivalent units or colors

acceptance_before_runtime_use: resolve required resource dependencies and review aliases
declare and test coordinate, unit and time conversions
check UV, materials, alpha and animation against references
validate import and playback in the chosen Godot version

static_sample.purpose: local geometry diagnostics only; not scene reconstruction
